entities.name: G-G-E
entities.description: A method that divides retrieved subgraphs into smaller ones, compares similarity with the query, removes low-similarity subgraphs, and merges the rest.

entities.name: Munikoti et al.

entities.name: KagNet
entities.description: A method that decomposes retrieved paths into triplets and reranks them based on confidence scores from knowledge graph embeddings.

entities.description: A strategy proposed by Wang et al. and Kim et al. to prune irrelevant graph data by calling LLMs to check relevance.
